scope: Connected related-Bandido RAM data/readback and memory-request observations; transaction timing remains open

memory_request.STSTB: 4B LS08 pins 1/2 take inverted phi1 TTL and CPU SYNC; output 3 clocks status latch 1E
memory_request.RAMSTB_n: 3F LS00 pins 1/2 take STSTB and CPU A14; output 3 connects READY flip-flop 3D CLR_n pin 13. The drawn address input is A14, not the latched MEMR status bit.
memory_request.readback_clear: 4F/4G CLR pin1 share RAMSTB_n from 3F output3 across sheets 35/36; READY 3D CLR pin13 shares that net. Full pulse width and READY response remain unqualified.

ram_dataflow.video_RD: 4E/4H LS08 outputs buffer 4116 DO0..DO7 to CP2 RD0..RD7 and CPU readback latches. The shared other-input net is held high by R4 1k to +5 V, not phase controlled. DRAM valid-output timing remains open.
ram_dataflow.4F_data: LS174 D3/pin6=RD0, D5/pin13=RD1, D6/pin14=RD2, D4/pin11=RD3; Q3/Q5/Q6/Q4 feed DI10/DI11/DI12/DI13
ram_dataflow.4G_data: LS174 D1..D4 receive RD4..RD7; Q1..Q4 feed DI14..DI17
ram_dataflow.4F_controls: D1 pin3 receives Q2 pin5 feedback; Q1 pin2 drives RDY IN and 4T pin1. D2 pin4 is tied high; Q2 feeds D1 and 4T pins2/4. HREAD_n separately enters 4T pin5. LS86 output6 drives readback CLK pin9; output3 is Q1 XOR Q2.
ram_dataflow.separation: CPU readback latches and the parallel video RD bus are distinct paths. Do not model the video RD byte as automatically held by 4F/4G.
